assumption: Initial cold start consumes versioned outcome labels and supplied matched groups; automatic matched-control construction is deferred.

signals.description: Revenue and earnings growth are strong enough to suggest expectations may lag reality.
false_positive_patterns: One-time rebound from a depressed base
hindsight_risk_notes: Do not use later quarters to label the inflection as obvious.
signals.logic: Fire when revenue growth, earnings growth, and operating margin together show an inflection, with revenue growth weighted most heavily.
signals.name: Fundamental revenue acceleration
signals.promotion_reason: promoted: passed prevalence, lift, and control-evidence gates

signals.description: Price trend is already improving before the later outcome window.
false_positive_patterns: Short-term rebound inside a long downtrend
hindsight_risk_notes: The rule must be measured before the outcome window starts.
signals.logic: Fire when 20-day and 60-day returns are positive enough to show early confirmation without requiring the later surge.
signals.name: Market early confirmation
signals.promotion_reason: promoted: passed prevalence, lift, and control-evidence gates

signals.description: Sell-side target price implies upside while structured fundamentals are not deteriorating.
false_positive_patterns: Stale target prices after a business slowdown
Targets clustered above price after broad market drawdowns
hindsight_risk_notes: Target prices must be available as of the packet date.
signals.logic: Fire when target-price upside is positive and at least one growth feature is supportive.
signals.name: Analyst expectation gap
signals.promotion_reason: promoted: passed prevalence, lift, and control-evidence gates

signals.description: Multiple known catalysts are scheduled near the as-of date.
false_positive_patterns: Catalyst calendar is crowded but low materiality
hindsight_risk_notes: Only catalysts known as of the packet date may count.
signals.logic: Fire when the packet contains at least one near-term catalyst and score higher for two or more.
signals.name: Catalyst density
signals.promotion_reason: promoted: passed prevalence, lift, and control-evidence gates

signals.description: Growth is visible while common valuation ratios are not extreme.
false_positive_patterns: Low multiple because the market correctly expects growth to fade
Cyclical peak earnings make valuation look deceptively cheap
hindsight_risk_notes: Do not use post-surge valuation to decide there was room before the surge.
signals.logic: Fire when revenue growth is positive and P/E or price-to-sales leaves room for multiple expansion instead of already discounting perfection.
signals.name: Valuation room with growth
signals.promotion_reason: promoted: passed prevalence, lift, and control-evidence gates

signals.description: Recent dollar volume is expanding relative to the medium-term baseline.
false_positive_patterns: Temporary volume burst from non-repeatable news
Liquidity expands after most repricing has already happened
hindsight_risk_notes: Measure volume expansion before the outcome window.
signals.logic: Fire when 20-day average dollar volume is meaningfully above the 60-day baseline.
signals.name: Liquidity expansion
signals.promotion_reason: promoted: passed prevalence, lift, and control-evidence gates
